paragraphs.content: Completed a software engineering internship at Viator, a Tripadvisor company, where I delivered end-to-end features serving millions of users across the platform. I worked within a cross-functional Agile team, participating in sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives.

My responsibilities included building and maintaining microservices, auditing and resolving 500 errors using observability and logging tools, writing unit and Playwright end-to-end tests, and conducting code reviews on merge requests. I also worked with databases and APIs, contributed to CI/CD pipelines, optimised performance, and presented technical findings to stakeholders.

Selected as 1 of 20 students (top 5%) to serve as a lab demonstrator based on outstanding academic performance. I facilitated weekly sessions for over 30 students, guiding them through practical exercises and reinforcing core concepts.

My responsibilities included breaking down complex technical ideas for students at varying skill levels, providing individualised feedback, and evaluating over 100 lab reports. This role strengthened both my technical communication and my ability to convey information clearly under time constraints.

Built a freelance invoice management application for London Science College, initially as a JavaFX desktop app and later redesigned as a full-stack web application using React.js, FastAPI, and MariaDB hosted on a VPS. The system reduced manual data entry by 80% and serves over 500 recurring customers.

I engineered a custom PDF generation solution to avoid costly third-party APIs, implemented auto-fill features for common fields, and ensured cross-platform compatibility. The web rebuild introduced a modern interface with real-time database lookups, significantly improving the billing workflow.

Worked as a freelance web developer for London Science College, building a 10+ page website using WordPress with custom JavaScript and PHP plugins. I delivered a responsive, user-friendly site that achieved a 90% client satisfaction rating.

I also developed a homework management portal using JavaScript that served over 100 students, featuring a calendar-based assignment system for teachers and students. The project involved working within Wix's constrained environment, requiring creative solutions to overcome platform limitations.

Worked as a summer camp tutor at FunTech, teaching Python programming and Unity Game Coder to young learners. I led a team of 9 tutors and helped boost student motivation by 30% through engaging, hands-on sessions.

My responsibilities included delivering structured course content on a tight schedule, setting up tech devices, and coordinating with the tutor team to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. This role sharpened my leadership, organisation, and technical communication skills.

Tutored GCSE students in Maths and Physics for over two years at London Science College, working alongside a team of 40+ tutors. My students achieved an average 30% grade improvement over the course of their sessions.

This long-term role developed my patience, communication, and ability to adapt explanations to different learning styles. Collaborating closely with other tutors also enhanced my teamworking skills and consistency in delivering quality education.
